headline: Weathered Expanse Rages as Passage Battle Intensifies
war_summary: Since the midnight edition the wires show Weathered Expanse still busiest with five changes in two hours to the 03:11 cutoff and 57 on the day about Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk, holdings listed at six Warden and three Colonial with day losses of 8,044 Colonial and 12,695 Warden. Callahan's Passage has quickened to six changes in two hours and 31 on the day to 02:43 about The Crumbling Passage and Scath Passing, holdings eight Warden and two Colonial. Mooring County reports three changes in two hours to the cutoff about The Wind Hills, Wiccwalk and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, holdings eleven Warden and one Colonial. Stlican Shelf adds three changes in two hours to 01:20 about Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost, holdings four Warden and five Colonial. Palantine Berm stirs anew with one change in two hours to 01:16 about Leiri Hermanni, while Linn Mercy logs three changes to 01:32 about Rotdust. Fisherman's Row and Stema Landing have gone quiet in the last two hours, last heard at 23:55 and 00:28, and Nevish Line remains silent since 19:29.
